questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

• PONSNOMP → MN **PO** S / M **N** PO **S / N** N **O** OS / M **M** P B S

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding / subtracting / multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is NOT allowed)

(8, 44, 3)

(12, 60, 3)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **(First number + Third number) × 4 = Second number 

 
• (8, 44, 3) → (8 + 3) × 4 = 11 × 4 = 44
 
• (12, 60, 3) → (12 + 3) × 4 = 15 × 4 = 60

Similarly,

 
• (12, 68, 5) → → (12 + 5) × 4 = 17 × 4 = 68

Hence, '**(12, 68, 5)**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the * signs and to balance the given equation.

150 * 3 * 10 * 2 * 7 * 46

Select the set in which the number are related in the same way as the numbers of the given sets. (NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(31, 47, 35)

(51, 67, 55)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **First number + 16 = Second number; Second number - 12 = Third number

 
• (31, 47, 35) → 31 + 16 = 47; 47 - 12 = 35
 
• (51, 67, 55) → 51 + 16 = 67; 67 - 12 = 55

Similarly,

 
• (13, 29, 17) → 13 + 16 = 29; 29 - 12 = 17

Hence, '**(13, 29, 17)**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word. (The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

Orthopaedic : Bone :: Cardiologist : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **First one is an expert physician of the second one.

 
• Orthopaedic : Bone → Orthopaedic surgeons are devoted to the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of disorders of the bones.

Similarly,

 
• Cardiologist : ? → A cardiologist is a physician who's an expert in the care of your heart

Hence, '**Heart**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by four conclusions numbered I, II, III and IV. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some coolers are mixers.

Some mixers are scissors.

Some scissors are knives.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some knives are mixers.

II. Some scissors are coolers.

III. Some knives are coolers.

IV. No knife is a mixer.

options.text: Only conclusions III and IV follow
Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions II and IV follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b7dfff09c46ca3c66e2425c56c12e6a74c6ccde2a7ca6d059358b201938439b.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some knives are mixers. → Does not follow (There is no definite relation between knives and scissors. Hence, false)

II. Some scissors are coolers. → Does not follow (There is no definite relation between coolers and scissors. Hence, false)

III. Some knives are coolers. → Does not follow (There is no definite relation between knives and coolers. Hence, false)

IV. No knife is a mixer. → Does not follow (There is no definite relation between knives and mixer. Hence, false)

Hence, ‘**None of the conclusions follow**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which of the following is a leap year?
questions.solution:
• 1076 → 1076 is completely divisible by 4.
 
• 1675 → 1675 is not completely divisible by 4.
 
• 1354 → 1354 is not completely divisible by 4.
 
• 1998 → 1998 is not completely divisible by 4.

Therefore, 1076 is a leap year.

Hence, ‘**1076**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: Pointing to Suresha, I said, “She is the daughter of the brother of the son of my wife.” How am I related to Suresha?
questions.solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4241c61bb54f919ba85374e27a41dfeddc8a1ceac4b526b11e7133ce072009ee.png] 

Brother of the son of my wife → My wife's son's brother is my son.

Daughter of the brother of the son of my wife → My son's daughter is my granddaughter.

Therefore, Suresha is granddaughter of the person 'I'.

Hence, ‘**Grandfather**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: Three of the following four triads are alike in a certain way as they are formed by performing same mathematical operations among themselves and thus form a group. Which triad does NOT belong to that group?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **(Second number - Third number)² = First number

 
• 36 ∶ 13 ∶ 7 → (13 - 7)2 = 62 = 36
 
• 16 ∶ 9 ∶ 5 → (9 - 5)2 = 42 = 16
 
• 72 ∶ 16 ∶ 8 → (16 - 8)2 = 82 = 64 ≠ 72
 
• 1 ∶ 3 ∶ 2 → (3 - 2)2 = 12 = 1

Hence, '72 ∶ 16 ∶ 8' is the correct answer.
